original_test_intent: Perform one owner-approved CPLD upgrade or downgrade through supported Redfish and prove authenticated image acceptance, terminal task success, one defined BMC reset and recovered CPLD, BMC and host health.
original_method: Bind the exact board CPLD and signed compatible image, preserve baseline, execute the vendor UpdateService under attended control, monitor programming/task/reset/console, then verify version and platform recovery.
manual_activity: The owner selects direction/image and validates board compatibility and recovery; an operator supervises stable power, console, programming/task/reset and stops on any anomaly while automation performs only the approved workflow.
required_inputs: Selected upgrade or downgrade and authenticated image digest
Stable power, independent console and rollback/external-programmer recovery
safety_requirements: Require explicit approval and exact board/image match
Use only documented authenticated Redfish workflow
Keep power stable and prohibit concurrent firmware writes
Do not clear logs before baseline
Monitor task, reset, console and board/host health
agent_execution_scope: Verify target CPLD, image, direction, signature and compatibility
Preserve baseline and start task/reset/console monitoring
Execute only the approved Redfish CPLD transfer and observe terminal state
Verify one defined reset, CPLD version and BMC/BIOS/OS/device health
Do not select image, recover autonomously or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve board target, image, direction, window and recovery
Confirm stable power and console/external recovery

command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the board-vendor Redfish CPLD UpdateService client/schema with exact selector, trusted transport and task monitoring only after all approval and recovery gates pass.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Upgrade/downgrade, Redfish, single-reset criterion and 15/15-minute fields are retained; exactly one direction is selected per run.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run a board-bound baseline-transfer-program-task-reset-recovery state machine with immutable image identity.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds missing CPLD identity, image authenticity, power/console and external recovery controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; successful programming, target version, reset behavior and recovered platform health remain mandatory.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong image or power interruption can leave board logic unbootable and may require an external programmer.

project_override_considerations: The project may choose upgrade or downgrade and supported transfer mode, but must bind the exact CPLD/board revision, authenticated image, one-reset semantics and validated rollback or external recovery.
expected_evidence: Approval, board/CPLD identity, current/target versions and image digest/signature
Exactly one defined reset plus console/OOB timeline
Recovery record if invoked and engineer-owned verdict
